name: Extracted conventions can be judged and merged into a skill
description: Reach Skills Lab → Conventions for acme/payments-api, confirm the three seeded candidates render with their evidence (file:line) and confidence, then accept one and confirm the toolbar counter moves to '1 of 3 accepted' and 'Create skill' becomes usable. Opens the create-skill modal and confirms the merged draft carries the mandatory severity line ('Report a **WARNING**') and an 'Attach to agent' field — the step without which a created skill reaches no review — then cancels rather than saving, so the flow stays read-only. Exercises ConventionsView / ConventionCard / CreateSkillFromConventionsModal plus the skill-draft endpoint, which persists nothing. NO model call: the candidates and the scan row are seeded (see server/src/db/seed.ts SEED_CONVENTIONS), and the draft is built from rows already in the DB. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
